archetypes.name: dyn-score-consensus
archetypes.rationale: Scoring semantics changed across shared vote math and downstream scoreboards.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed scoring rule in python/voting.py and its use by review, plan-review, and progress-report callers. Check edge cases for one, two, and three recorded voters, missing severity cells, NO votes with high severity, and legacy no-scope rows. Verify the tests pin the intended +1 versus +2 split without masking caller regressions. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-rubric-sync
archetypes.rationale: Prompt and documentation wording must match the new point math.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare the competition notice, voter severity rubric, plan-review reference, and shared voting protocol against the implemented scoring rule. Look for stale YES-only, any-high, or majority-high wording. Confirm the body_severity exclusion remains clear while panel severity source text matches the all-recorded-panel-votes rule. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
